notes_body: LICK SESSION-Z BACKUP. Hidden companion of 'Lick response larger after stroke'. WHY: the post-stroke SD rise is a cortex-wide gain (docs/status/SD_RISE_2026-11-04.md). Session z-scoring removes that gain whether it is biological or not, so read raw = absolute dF/F change, session-z = the change beyond the global gain. Normalization = SD_RISE variant (c): each session x ROI divided by its SD over all samples of the same lick windows (-2..+3 s, same licks, before baselining).

Cued (first cued lick, AUC 0..1.0 s / the animal's own pre), change vs pre acute / subacute / chronic: contra tjM1 raw +.51* / +.40* / +.41*, session-z +.05 / +.14* / +.15*; contra SSp-m raw +.49* / +.46* / +.41*, z +.04 / +.13* / +.13*; ALM contra raw +.37 (n.s.) / +.27* / +.17*, z +.06 / +.09* / +.05. ITI (docked spout) AUC 0..0.5 s / own pre: contra tjM1 raw +1.25* / +.85* / +1.14*, z +.65* / +.52* / +.68*; contra SSp-m raw +1.23* / +.78* / +1.00*, z +.68* / +.46* / +.59*. * = paired nested bootstrap 95 % CI (animals -> sessions) excludes 0.

notes_body: Fig 14.9 (KEY), cued row, rebuild 11-11 (no newer version of this figure exists; the 11-16 shared-y redraw is of Fig 14.13, lick_balance_angle). Pairs ALM, tjM1, SSp-m, SSp-n: X_right (contralesional) vs X_left (ipsilesional), raw dF/F, same traces as Fig 14.7; per session and spout log2(contra AUC 0-1 s / ipsi AUC 0-1 s).

Pre (per animal, tjM1): close ipsi +.46 to +.58, close contra -.24 to -.94, far contra -.29 to -.84. Change vs pre (cued, 0-1 s; acute / subacute / chronic): far contra tjM1 +.58 / +.36 / +.31, SSp-n +.93 / +.63 / +.59, orofacial +.59 / +.37 / +.33 (every animal positive in every epoch); far mid orofacial +.21 / +.12 / +.16 (4/4 acute); far ipsi orofacial -.06 n.s. / +.12 / +.18; close ipsi orofacial -.18 acute (CI excludes 0, away from balance), then n.s. Distance x epoch interaction p < .001 in tjM1, SSp-n and the pool (mixed-model LR test), so the rebalancing may follow reach distance as well as direction (close vs far: Fig 14.11). Same measure as the read-out offset's balance term (section 4, Figs 12.17-12.21). Licks: LP video licks (cam4), attempted trials. PROVISIONAL.

CAVEAT (encoding page Fig 14.18): for CUED licks the balance shift is largely the landing error seen through a target code. For ITI bout starts (response balance over 0..0.5 s), the balance at matched landing angle (Fig 14.13, ITI 0..0.5 s re-render 11-17) shifts toward the contralesional hemisphere in ALM (+0.06, p .005; subacute +0.09, chronic +0.06, p .02 each) but not in tjM1 (+0.02, p .58; chronic 3 / 4 animals, PS92 opposite) or the orofacial pool (+0.04, p .16); SSp-n chronic +0.11 (p .04).

Spout x epoch LR p .084 ALM, .016 tjM1, .050 SSp-m, .081 SSp-n, .005 orofacial. (0..1 s window: acute +0.50 / +0.88 / +0.88 / +0.65 / +0.67, chronic ALM +0.18; spout x epoch p .021 ALM, .016 orofacial, .098 SSp-m, .24 SSp-n, tjM1 fit degenerate.)
